BiblicalUsage: Raamiah comes with Zerubbabel, Jeshua and Nehemiah, among the men of the people of Israel who return. One verse, one name in the number.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men who came back with Zerubbabel are named one by one, and Raamiah is on the list.
